t: The Brenner uPVC Cleaner is a trade-strength cleaning solution formulated to remove stubborn dirt, grease, and grime from plastic surfaces. This ready-to-use liquid is ideal for window fitters, site cleaners, and property maintenance teams restoring weathered frames, doors, cladding, and conservatories. The non-abrasive formula lifts tough outdoor marks quickly without scratching, ensuring a clean, professional finish on 1-litre bottle applications.
b: Brings Tired uPVC Back to Life
